name: Kibbeh bel Soniyeh
steps: Soak the bulgur wheat in water for 15-20 minutes, then drain well.
For the filling: sauté the diced onions with walnuts and pine nuts until golden, season with sumac and set aside.
For the base and top layer: blend the ground meat, soaked bulgur, remaining onion, marjoram, basil, cumin, cinnamon, salt and pepper into a smooth, sticky paste (a food processor works well).
Press half the kibbeh mixture into an oiled baking tray, spread the filling evenly on top, then cover with the remaining kibbeh mixture and smooth flat.
Score into diamonds or squares, drizzle with a little olive oil.
Bake at 200°C for 35-40 minutes until golden brown on top.
notes: Freezes well both baked and unbaked — if freezing unbaked, bake straight from frozen adding 10-15 extra minutes.
